featuresPage.heroSub: From live mandi prices and AI-driven sell signals to verified buyer connections and end-to-end deal tracking — AgriLink gives every stakeholder the tools to make confident, data-backed decisions.
featuresPage.card1Desc: Real-time modal, min, and max prices from AGMARKNET across all reporting mandis. 7, 30, and 90-day trend charts show exactly where the market is heading.
featuresPage.card2Desc: Our explainable AI weighs price momentum, weather, MSP, crop calendar, and forecasts to give you a clear recommendation.
featuresPage.card3Desc: Diesel-indexed transport cost calculations find the market that nets you the most after freight, not just the highest price.
featuresPage.card4Desc: Admin-verified buyers and sellers with full offer threads, counter-offers with price references, and a complete audit trail.
featuresPage.card5Desc: From match to offer to logistics to payment — every step logged in an append-only ledger. Disputes handled transparently.
featuresPage.dd1Body: AGMARKNET data is ingested daily, processed into 7/30/90-day trends, and enriched with rainfall anomaly data from NASA POWER and weather from Open-Meteo.
featuresPage.dd1Bullet1: Modal, min, and max prices for every crop × market combination
featuresPage.dd1Bullet2: 7-day weather forecast with humidity and rainfall impact
featuresPage.dd1Bullet3: Statewide trend analytics accessible without login
featuresPage.dd1Bullet4: MSP gap analysis shows if market is above or below support price
featuresPage.dd2Body: Every recommendation is explainable. We show the weighted score and every factor — price momentum, arrival trends, weather pressure, MSP comparison, crop calendar phase, and mandi holidays — so you understand exactly why.
featuresPage.dd2Bullet1: Weighted multi-factor scoring with full transparency
featuresPage.dd2Bullet2: Short-term price forecast based on historical patterns
featuresPage.dd2Bullet3: Crop calendar awareness for peak arrival warnings
featuresPage.dd2Bullet4: Decision Brief that fuses all signals into plain-language actions
featuresPage.dd3Body: The matching engine scores every farmer–buyer pairing by quantity fit, price overlap, distance, grade, and delivery timing. Then a full pipeline tracks offer → logistics → delivery → payment.
featuresPage.dd3Bullet1: Multi-dimensional match scoring with tier labels
featuresPage.dd3Bullet2: Counter-offers with midpoint suggestion and price references
featuresPage.dd3Bullet3: Diesel-indexed transport cost estimation with OSRM routing
featuresPage.dd3Bullet4: Instalment payment tracking with audit trail
featuresPage.dd4Body: Small farmers pool their produce to negotiate as one large lot. Buyers post forward bids so farmers can lock a price before harvest, reducing market risk for both sides.
featuresPage.dd4Bullet1: Pool creation with aggregation tracking and floor price
featuresPage.dd4Bullet2: Buyer candidate scoring against the pooled lot
featuresPage.dd4Bullet3: Forward bids with delivery windows and grade requirements
featuresPage.dd4Bullet4: Price realisation scorecard: what you got vs the open mandi
featuresPage.closingHeading: Join thousands making smarter agricultural decisions
featuresPage.closingSub: Create a free account in seconds. No credit card, no commitment — just better decisions from day one.

howItWorksPage.heroSub: Three to five steps from checking a price to getting paid — tailored for farmers, buyers, and FPOs. Every action is transparent and tracked.
howItWorksPage.farmer1Body: Select your crop and nearest market. See the live modal price, a 7-day trend chart, the MSP gap, and the best market after diesel-indexed transport cost.
howItWorksPage.farmer2Body: Our AI weighs price momentum, weather pressure, crop calendar phase, and arrivals to produce an explainable signal — every factor and its weight shown on screen.
howItWorksPage.farmer3Body: Photograph a mandi slip to auto-fill the form, or enter crop, quantity, grade, and asking price manually. Your lot becomes visible to matched buyers instantly.
howItWorksPage.farmer4Title: Match, negotiate, and close a deal
howItWorksPage.farmer4Body: Receive scored match proposals from verified buyers. Use the offer thread to negotiate with price references (mandi modal, MSP, buyer band). Accept to create a deal.
howItWorksPage.farmer5Body: Track logistics, confirm delivery, and record payments with UPI/bank references — every step in an append-only ledger. Raise a dispute if anything goes wrong.
howItWorksPage.buyer1Body: Specify crop, quantity, price band, minimum grade, and delivery window. Set a delivery district so the matcher can score lots by distance to your location.
howItWorksPage.buyer2Body: Check statewide price trends, gainers and fallers, and the public Explore dashboard — no login needed. Use alerts to get notified when a target price is hit.
howItWorksPage.buyer3Body: Each match shows a multi-dimensional score: quantity fit, price overlap, distance, grade, and delivery timing. Strong matches are highlighted for quick action.
howItWorksPage.buyer4Body: Make offers, counter with price references, and use the suggested midpoint. Once accepted, a binding deal is created with agreed price and quantity.
howItWorksPage.buyer5Body: Advance the deal pipeline through logistics → delivered → paid → closed. Record instalment payments. The full audit trail is visible to both parties and admins.
howItWorksPage.fpo1Body: Set a crop, target quantity, floor price, and aggregation point. Invite nearby farmers to join and commit their individual quantities.
howItWorksPage.fpo2Body: Watch the pool fill in real time. See each member's committed quantity and asking price, plus the pooled aggregate position.
howItWorksPage.fpo3Body: Once the pool reaches critical mass, lock intake. The matcher surfaces buyer demands scored against the pooled lot — visible only to the organizer.
howItWorksPage.fpo4Body: The FPO negotiates on behalf of all members, leveraging combined volume for better prices. Accept to create a deal linked to the pool.
howItWorksPage.fpo5Body: Track delivery, payments, and the realisation scorecard — what each member got vs the open mandi price. Every transaction is auditable.
howItWorksPage.trust1Body: Every buyer and seller can be admin-verified with GST / licence references.
howItWorksPage.trust2Body: AGMARKNET, Open-Meteo, NASA POWER, OSRM — all government or open sources.
howItWorksPage.trust3Body: Every offer, payment, and logistics update is logged and cannot be altered.
howItWorksPage.trust4Body: Works without internet. Lots are queued and synced when connectivity returns.
howItWorksPage.closingHeading: Your first price check is 30 seconds away
howItWorksPage.closingSub: Sign up with your phone number, select your crop and market, and get an instant sell-or-wait recommendation. Free forever.

marketInsightsPage.heroSub: Government mandi data, weather intelligence, and transport cost analytics — fused into actionable insights you can trust. No black boxes, every number traceable to its source.
marketInsightsPage.capSub: We combine government agricultural data, meteorological sources, and logistics analytics to create insights no single dataset can provide.
marketInsightsPage.cap1Body: 7, 30, and 90-day trend lines for every crop × market pair. Spot patterns, identify the best selling windows, and understand seasonality at a glance.
marketInsightsPage.cap2Body: Diesel-indexed transport cost modelling using real road distances from OSRM. The highest mandi price isn't always the best — we show you the net figure.
marketInsightsPage.cap3Body: 7-day weather forecasts from Open-Meteo and historical rainfall data from NASA POWER. See how weather pressure could impact crop arrivals and prices.
marketInsightsPage.cap4Body: Automatic comparison of current market prices against government Minimum Support Prices. Know instantly if you're selling below MSP and by how much.
marketInsightsPage.cap5Body: Flags any market where the latest price deviates more than 20% from its 7-day average. Early warning for unusual price movements or data errors.
marketInsightsPage.cap6Body: Set a target price for any crop × market combination. We'll notify you the moment the mandi price crosses your threshold — above or below.
marketInsightsPage.sourcesHeading: Every number traceable to its source
marketInsightsPage.sourcesSub: We only use government and open data sources. No proprietary black boxes.
marketInsightsPage.previewSub: Statewide price transparency, top gainers and fallers, crop price tables, and live platform activity — no login required. This is the public intelligence layer for everyone.
marketInsightsPage.closingHeading: Make your next decision with data, not guesswork
marketInsightsPage.closingSub: Create a free account and get personalised insights for your crops and markets. Or start with the public Explore dashboard — no login required.

aboutPage.heroSub: AgriLink is building India's most transparent agricultural marketplace — where every price is traceable, every recommendation is explainable, and every farmer can make data-driven decisions.
aboutPage.missionBody: To bridge the information gap between farmers and buyers using transparent data, explainable AI, and a fair marketplace — so every agricultural decision is informed, not a gamble.
aboutPage.missionNote: Every recommendation shows the numbers behind it — nothing is a black box.
aboutPage.visionBody: A future where every farmer in India has access to the same market intelligence as the largest institutional buyers — leveling the playing field through technology and open data.
aboutPage.visionNote: Built Maharashtra-first, architected for all of India.
aboutPage.value1Body: Every insight is backed by verifiable data from government and open sources. We never guess — we measure.
aboutPage.value2Body: Our AI shows every factor, every weight, every score. Users understand exactly why a recommendation is made.
aboutPage.value3Body: We connect farmers directly to verified buyers, eliminating unnecessary intermediaries and creating fair deals.
aboutPage.value4Body: Every transaction is logged in an append-only ledger. Prices, offers, payments — all visible and auditable.
aboutPage.challengeHeading: Price discovery and market linkage for farmers
aboutPage.challengeBody1: Indian farmers often sell at disadvantageous prices because they lack real-time market intelligence and direct access to buyers. The information asymmetry leads to post-harvest losses, below-MSP sales, and reliance on intermediaries who capture disproportionate margins.
aboutPage.challengeBody2: AgriLink addresses this by making government mandi data actionable — transforming raw AGMARKNET records into clear sell/wait signals, best-market routing after transport cost, and a verified buyer-seller marketplace with end-to-end deal tracking.
aboutPage.tech1Body: Full interface in English, Hindi, and Marathi — native speakers contributed translations for agricultural terminology.
aboutPage.tech2Body: Works without internet. Lot listings queue locally and sync when connectivity returns. Price data falls back to a committed snapshot.
aboutPage.tech3Body: GPS or manual location sets the context for nearby markets, matched buyers, storage facilities, and FPOs — all distance-ranked.
aboutPage.tech4Body: Large touch targets (44px min), proper ARIA labels, focus-visible outlines, and a mobile-first responsive layout.
aboutPage.tech5Body: Every AI recommendation shows the factors, weights, and score. Users can drill into why the system says sell, wait, or hold.
aboutPage.tech6Body: No subscriptions, no hidden fees, no premium tiers. Built as a public-good platform for agricultural communities.
aboutPage.closingHeading: Better data. Fairer markets. Stronger farmers.
aboutPage.closingSub: Whether you're a farmer looking for the best price, a buyer seeking verified sellers, or an FPO pooling volume — AgriLink is built for you.
